test_ROIPooler_ROIAlignV2_vs_ROIAlignRot: test that ROIAlignV2 and ROIAlignRotated poolers produce matching outputs on CPU and CUDA devices
test_ROIPooler_scriptability: test that an ROIAlignV2 ROIPooler can be scripted with torch.jit.script and produces identical output
test_ROIPooler_no_images: test that ROIPooler returns an empty tensor with correct shape when given zero images
test_ROIPooler_tracing: test that an ROIAlign ROIPooler can be traced with torch.jit.trace and handles variable box counts
review_TestROIPooler_class: review the TestROIPooler unittest class and its methods for ROIAlignV2, ROIAlignRotated, scriptability, and tracing tests
